title: channel
summary: Benilla defines the full chat-channel subsystem: CMSG_JOIN/LEAVE_CHANNEL, CMSG_CHANNEL_LIST/PASSWORD/OWNER/SET_OWNER/MODERATOR/UNMODERATOR/MUTE/UNMUTE/INVITE/KICK/BAN/UNBAN/ANNOUNCEMENTS/MODERATE (shared cstrings body), SMSG_CHANNEL_NOTIFY (32 notice types with per-notice tails), and SMSG_CHANNEL_LIST (roster). MSUI has none of it - the only trace is a comment in Engine/UI/ChatFrameLaw.cs; no channel opcode exists even in Net/Opcodes.cs.

openItems.text: CMSG_JOIN_CHANNEL / CMSG_LEAVE_CHANNEL: no senders - custom/world channels cannot be joined
CMSG_CHANNEL_* moderation family (LIST, PASSWORD, OWNER, SET_OWNER, MODERATOR, UNMODERATOR, MUTE, UNMUTE, INVITE, KICK, BAN, UNBAN, ANNOUNCEMENTS, MODERATE): no senders
SMSG_CHANNEL_NOTIFY: no handler (join/leave/kick/invite/owner notices with typed tails are undecodable)
